name: The Saltreach
description: A pale desert of salt and sand, crossed by a single beaten road.

dune_road.name: Dune Road
dune_road.description: The road runs between low dunes, its ruts filled with wind-blown sand. The heat comes up off the ground in waves.

dry_wash.name: Dry Wash
dry_wash.description: A broad gully where a river used to run, its bed cracked like old pottery. The road dips into it and out again on the far side.

village_approach.name: Approach to Dunhallow
village_approach.description: Flat roofs and a green smear of date palms rise out of the heat haze ahead. The road widens here and runs up to a low mud-brick gate.

salt_flats.name: The Salt Flats
salt_flats.description: A white plain, flat to the horizon, crusted and creaking underfoot. The sky is too bright to look at, and the heat comes up through your boots.

glass_dunes.name: The Glass Dunes
glass_dunes.description: Dunes of fused sand, glittering and sharp, as if lightning once struck the whole field at once. Wind sings in the ridges. A faint path winds south between them. To the east the dunes give way to a great pale sea of sand.

east.failure_message: The sand sea is no place to walk: you need the royal skimmer, and it is the king's to lend.

bleached_ridge.name: The Bleached Ridge
bleached_ridge.description: A ridge of sun-bleached bone-white stone, the ribs of some great dead thing. A chest sticks out of the sand in its shadow. Past the ridge, the ground falls away.

sinkhole_rim.name: The Sinkhole
sinkhole_rim.description: The desert ends in a hole. A great ragged mouth in the ground, a hundred paces across, with a path of tumbled stone winding down its wall to a darkness that breathes out cool, wet air. After days of sand, the smell of water is almost unbearable.
